messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — I ran a full link-scan over the runtime guide + KB and found 3 broken items: two images still pointing at staging S3 URLs and one dead anchor in /docs/guides/runtime-onboarding. Small plan below. :frowning:

docs-bot: link-scan report: 3 broken links detected (scan id scan-2026-03-18-1). Paths affected: /docs/guides/runtime-onboarding, /kb/runbook/ops, /images/staging/...

maria: I can own the runtime-onboarding path. I'll rehost the images to the CDN and update anchors in that doc.

jamal: I can handle the anchor sed sweep across the repo. Command I usually run for this kind of quick replace: 
```bash
rg -n "#old-anchor" -U docs | cut -d: -f1 | uniq | xargs -n1 sed -i 's/#old-anchor/#new-anchor/g'
git add -A && git commit -m "docs: fix old-anchor -> new-anchor" && git push origin docs-link-fix
```
I'll run locally, push a branch, open a PR.

sophie: Please include a short verification checklist in the PR: preview link (Netlify/preview), run markdownlint, and update the changelog entry. Tag me for review and I can merge after CI. :eyes: 

alex: @maria @jamal, rough ETA? We want this in docs-sprint-42; if either of you can't get it in today, we'll triage it for tomorrow.

maria: Aiming EOD PT. I'll bundle the image rehost + small alt-text fixes in the same PR (to avoid two quick merges).

jamal: Draft PR up now with the anchor fixes and a minor README tweak: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3210 (WIP). I listed the staging S3 keys in the description so infra can add redirects if needed.

maria: Left a comment on the PR about normalizing image filenames (no spaces, use kebab-case). Will push a follow-up commit in ~30m.

sophie: :thumbsup: tagging @sophie for merge once CI is green. Please add label `docs:link-sweep` and put a one-line QA note (how to preview).

alex: Also pinging infra: @infra-team can you confirm whether we should add 301 redirects from the staging S3 keys? Don't want external customers to see 404s during the swap.

infra-team: We can add redirects — need exact object keys/paths and desired destination. If you paste them in the PR description or here, we'll schedule the redirects for today.

jamal: Keys pasted in PR description (see the bottom). I also included a small test script to validate the new URLs before merge.

maria: Pushed the image filename normalization commit and updated alt text. PR now includes preview link.

sophie: CI finished and looks clean. I ran the preview and spot-checked the affected headings. Leaving one tiny nit about alt text wording, then I'll merge.

jamal: Addressed the nit and pushed.

sophie: Merged main at 3344556685. :tada: Added `docs:link-sweep` label and moved card to "Done (docs-sprint-42)".

alex: Thanks everyone — I'll re-run the link-scan and confirm closure. If scan shows anything else I'll reopen, otherwise I'll close scan-2026-03-18-1.

alex: Follow-up: post-merge scan clean. Marking this thread resolved and adding a note to the sprint board. Thanks!
